failureCause: The capture walker assumed fileId/file_id represented only a file fid and required a separate cid to navigate folders. Current File Management V8 proves the normalized 115Api model uses fileId as the ID for both files and directories, distinguished by isDirectory. Therefore a normalized folder can legitimately be {fileId, isDirectory:true} with no cid.
